_about.item_data: items.json (live API dump, 6 Nov 2026). Street Brawl variants ignored. The wiki's 'Enhanced'/'Corrupted' tabs are Street Brawl too.
_about.method: Every number is a *_prop in the item's own properties unless the data lacks it (then *_value, explained in notes). Semantics (per hit vs per second, triggers, stacking, what counts as spirit damage) come from the rendered deadlock.wiki pages fetched 6 Nov 2026. Where they disagree on a number, the API wins.
_about.sign_convention: Shred props are NEGATIVE in the data (e.g. BulletArmorReduction=-8 means -8 percentage points). A shred's value is one source in the reduction pool: total_reduction = 1 - prod(1 - r_i); final_resist = total_resist - total_reduction, can go negative (Damage_Resistance). effects.shred() takes abs().
_about.spirit_scaling: A prop's own scale_function gives its spirit scaling (ETechPower: value + SP x stat_scale). Some props scale with ELevelUpBoons (per boon) or healing_boon_scale instead. Those are NOT spirit scaling and are noted per item.
_about.uptime: Fraction of a sustained 1v1 fight the effect is active, or for cooldown effects the share of cooldown windows actually used. Assumptions are in each 'why'. Range-, melee- and headshot-dependent ones are guesses to be tuned per hero.
_about.empty_effects: An item with effects [] is listed ON PURPOSE: what it does is either plain stats the simulator already reads or range bonuses simulate.stats() already handles. Note that an empty list makes simulate.item_damage fall back to its naive path, which finds no damage props for these items.
_about.extension_stacks_prop_on_conditional_sta: Berserker and Glass Cannon carry stacks_prop on conditional_stat (value x stacks x uptime). effects.conditional_stats() ignores it today and would count a single stack.

mislabelled_props._meaning: Props with NO ConditionallyApplied flag that are in fact conditional (active-only, imbue-only, buff-only). data.Item.stat() reads them as permanent. They should be excluded like data.SCOPED_PROPS, and the conditional effect here then counts them correctly. Until then they are double counted (or, with no effect here, overcounted).
mislabelled_props._flag_semantics: IntrinsicallyProvidedInAbility is ambiguous: plain stat on Bullet Resist Shredder, Mystic Vulnerability, Siphon Bullets, Vampiric Burst, Infuser and Mystic Reverb's +8% lifesteal (all top-line on the wiki), but buff-only on Spiritual Overflow.

_about.disabled: None of the requested classes are disabled (all shopable=True, disabled None/False).

upgrade_magic_burst.name: Mystic Burst

effects.why: Charge-up item: fires on the first spirit-damage ability hit dealing >80 base damage after the 14s charge. Spirit casters hit that threshold most charge windows; weapon heroes may not.

upgrade_magic_burst.notes: Damage=40 flat; the API gives it no ETechPower scale_function. Threshold MinimumDamage=80 is checked on pre-mitigation spirit damage (wiki). Only spirit damage triggers it; separate damage instance after the ability. Charge-up, so cooldown reduction does not apply (wiki); AbilityCooldown and AbilityChargeUpTime are both 14. Procs on every hero hit by the same ability (multi-target ignored here). Spirit lifesteal heals from it (wiki).

upgrade_crackshot.name: Mystic Shot

effects.why: Fires with the next shot after the 8s cooldown; the cooldown starts even if the shot misses (wiki), so a few procs are wasted.

upgrade_crackshot.notes: Extra spirit bullet, 40 + 0.9 x SP. Uses AbilityCooldown (8s, matches wiki); ProcCooldown=1 is an internal lockout. Cannot crit, immune to evasion, hits before the regular bullet so bullet shred applied by it amplifies that shot (wiki).

upgrade_chain_lightning.name: Tesla Bullets

effects.why: Pure per-shot proc; the rate is already capped by ProcChance and the 0.2s ProcCooldown.

upgrade_chain_lightning.notes: 15% per shot (wiki: procs at most once per shot, so Ricochet/Split Shot do not raise it), 0.2s cooldown, 33 + 0.19 x SP spirit damage, reduced by spirit resist and falloff (wiki). Then chains to up to ChainCount=4 nearby enemies within 8m (multi-target ignored). BonusPerChain (also 33) is not explained anywhere I found; I assumed the primary target takes DamagePerChain only. Medium for that reason.

upgrade_toxic_bullets.name: Toxic Bullets

effects.why: Bleed needs build-up to 100% first (hero-specific number of shots, longer at range), then further shots refresh the 4s bleed. In a sustained fight on one target, roughly the first second or two is ramp, after which it stays up while you keep landing shots.

effects.reason: -40% healing received on the bleeding target (HealAmpReceivePenaltyPercent / HealAmpRegenPenaltyPercent): an anti-heal debuff, not damage.

upgrade_toxic_bullets.notes: DotHealthPercent=1.9 (+0.006 x SP) is % of target MAX health per second (wiki update log: 'Bleed damage increased from 1.7% to 1.9%'; enhanced tooltip reads '% DPS'), ticking every 0.5s for 4s = 7.6% max HP per application at 0 SP. It is spirit damage reduced by spirit resist; extended by ability duration. Does not build on Guardians/Walkers; Mid-boss is immune; 50% damage on troopers/denizens (DotMultiplerTroopers). Does not build with melee. BuildUpPerShot=1.28 is a multiplier on a per-hero table, not a percent.

upgrade_ethereal_bullets.name: Mercurial Magnum

effects.why: Bonus damage on the imbued ability's first hit, once per 14s charge-up; assumes the imbued ability is cast about once per charge.
+22% fire rate for 12s after casting the imbued ability, once per 14s charge: 12/14 = 0.86 if cast on charge, shaded down for casting late.

Every bullet of the magazine loaded by the imbued cast deals the bonus, so at most one clip per 14s charge-up (cap clip_per_window), cast on ~85% of charges. Was 'uptime 0.4 of all bullets', which valued it at ~140 DPS on Haze -- several times its gun. BulletsBonusMagicDamage is a PERCENT of base bullet damage (postfix %, label 'Base Bullet Damage'), not flat.

upgrade_ethereal_bullets.notes: Charge-up 14s (AbilityChargeUpTime; AbilityCooldown is 15 in the data, the wiki shows 14s). BonusFireRate has NO ConditionallyApplied flag in the API but is only active after a cast: see _about.mislabelled_props. The +20% clip and +7 SP are plain stats.

upgrade_capacitor.name: Capacitor

effects.why: Same per-shot shock as Tesla, with Capacitor's own numbers.
Active projectile every 40s; assumes it is used most cooldowns and lands.

effects.reason: Active also applies a 60% slow (3s), stops stamina use and silences movement items/abilities: crowd control.

upgrade_capacitor.notes: Upgrade of Tesla Bullets (20% chance, 43 + 0.19 x SP, chains to 6). Active Damage=100 has no spirit scaling in the data. Same BonusPerChain caveat as Tesla.

upgrade_headshot_booster.name: Headshot Booster

effects.why: The rate is already the headshot rate capped by the 9s cooldown; vs heroes only.

upgrade_headshot_booster.notes: +45 weapon damage on the next headshot against a HERO every 9s. Affected by falloff; for shotguns the centre pellet must headshot. Not on troopers.

upgrade_headhunter.name: Headhunter

effects.why: Headshot rate capped by the 8s cooldown; vs heroes only.
Same trigger as the bonus damage.

upgrade_headhunter.notes: HeadShotBonusDamage=75 has scale_function ELevelUpBoons 4.0, i.e. +4 per boon (not spirit). The simulator's `.at(spirit)` will treat the 4.0 as no-scale unless it handles ELevelUpBoons. HealPercentPerHeadshot=4 (+0.06 per boon, scale_function_healing_boon_scale): neither the API nor the wiki says what it is a percent of. pct_max_hp (own max HP) is my assumption, hence low.

upgrade_thermal_detonator.name: Alchemical Fire

effects.why: Shred only while the target stands in the 10m fire area: 5s per 30s cooldown = 0.17, minus time spent walking out.
Ramping area DoT (DPS -> DPSMax over ~4.5s, 10 instances). Wiki total 384 at +10 SP = ~3.9 x DPSMax(SP) per 30s cast; 0.8 for casts where the target leaves the fire early.
effects.added_by: main session, from the research's closed form

upgrade_thermal_detonator.notes: The shred scales with spirit power: BulletArmorReduction = -7 - 0.055 x SP (ETechPower stat_scale -0.055), so -12.5 at 100 SP. Because this item has an entry here, simulate.item_damage's naive 'Damage every cooldown' path is skipped, so its damage is 0 until the ramp is modelled.

upgrade_rupture.name: Decay

effects.reason: Damage per second = DotHealthPercent (1.95 + 0.003 x SP)% of the target's CURRENT health, ticking 1/s for 12s, on a 30s active. It is non-lethal and does not apply item procs (except Spirit Burn, per wiki). max_hp_dot would overstate it because it uses max health.
-55% healing received for the duration (anti-heal).

upgrade_rupture.notes: Targeted active, 20m + 0.1m x SP cast range. In 12 ticks on a target at full HP the current-HP rule gives about 20.9% of max HP at 0 SP (1-(1-0.0195)^12); less on a wounded target.

upgrade_discord.name: Scourge

effects.why: Aura around a friendly target (usually self) for 10s per 35s cooldown = 0.29, and only enemies within 10m are hit, so lower in ranged fights.

upgrade_discord.notes: MaxHealthPercentAsDPS = 2.3 + 0.0055 x SP % of enemy max HP per second, 0.25s ticks. The +40% spirit resist and +20% debuff resist on the target are conditional (flagged) and defensive, not modelled. Only one Scourge active per hero.

upgrade_mystic_reverb.name: Mystic Reverb

effects.reason: Imbued ability: every 6.25s, 50% of the first damage instance of the imbued ability is dealt, after 3s, to enemies within 16m of the hit target (pre-mitigation, then reduced by spirit resist). The wiki does not say whether the primary target takes it. Needs per-ability damage.
+22% spirit lifesteal on the imbued ability only (ImbueAbilityLifesteal), and a 32% slow.

upgrade_mystic_reverb.notes: The +8% spirit lifesteal (AbilityLifestealPercentHero, flagged IntrinsicallyProvidedInAbility) is a plain top-line stat on the wiki and is already read by the simulator. ImbueAbilityLifesteal=22 is NOT flagged conditional but only applies to the imbued ability; see _about.mislabelled_props. MaxHealthDamage=10 (ConditionallyApplied) is in the data but on no tooltip or wiki text: unknown.

upgrade_magic_shock.name: Tankbuster

effects.why: Charge-up 14s; needs a single spirit-damage ability hit of more than 165 (pre-resist). Since July 2026 it no longer procs off items (wiki update log).

effects.reason: Plus CurrentHealthDamage = 7.5% of the target's CURRENT health (after the triggering hit) per proc. The whole proc IGNORES spirit resist; the simulator's spirit_extra is multiplied by spirit resist.

upgrade_magic_shock.notes: Upgrade of Mystic Burst. Damage=40 has no spirit scaling in the data. Positive spirit resist does not stop the threshold; negative resist and damage amps help reach it (wiki).

upgrade_tech_damage_pulse.name: Torment Pulse

effects.why: Pulses every 1.4s against the two closest enemies within 9m; uptime is the share of the fight spent within 9m of the target.

upgrade_tech_damage_pulse.notes: 25 + 0.23 x SP per pulse. Counts as spirit damage for on-spirit-damage effects (Bullet Resist Shredder, Escalating Exposure, Mystic Vulnerability) per wiki, which justifies high uptime on those for builds holding it.

upgrade_spirit_burn.name: Spirit Burn

effects.why: Needs 500 spirit damage on one enemy inside 5s, then that enemy is immune for 20s. Spirit-heavy builds reach it most windows; others rarely.

effects.reason: Burn: DPS (24 + 0.06 x SP) for DebuffDuration 8s per proc (192 + 0.48 x SP total), once per 20s per enemy. The vocabulary has no flat DoT with spirit scaling; periodic_spirit on DPS would undercount 8x.
-70% healing received while burning.

upgrade_spirit_burn.notes: ExplosionDamage=50 has no spirit scaling. Since July 2026 it hits only the primary target and the cooldown is per target (wiki update log). Half damage on non-heroes. ImmunityDuration=20 scales with item cooldown reduction.

upgrade_berserker.name: Berserker

effects.why: One stack per 120 damage taken (pre-resist), stacks refresh for 10s, max 10. Taking ~200 DPS gets to max in ~6s and holds it. 0.6 = average share of the 10-stack maximum over a fight from first contact.

upgrade_berserker.notes: +7% weapon damage per stack, 10 stacks = +70%. NOTE: effects.conditional_stats() ignores stacks_prop today, so it would count +7% x 0.6. The intended value is value x stacks x uptime.

effects.reason: Active: 5 multishot for 5s per 27s. A target can only be hit once per multishot, and the stacking +8% weapon damage needs hitting more than one hero with an attack, so it adds nothing in a 1v1 single-target sim.

upgrade_weapon_backstabber.name: Stalker

effects.why: Wound applied by weapon/melee damage within 8m, 5s debuff, 6s cooldown: 0.83 while in close range; 0.4 assumes half the fight inside 8m.
One 5s wound per 6s cooldown while within 8m; same close-range share as the shred.

upgrade_weapon_backstabber.notes: Wound DoT = DPS 17 x DebuffDuration 5s = 85 spirit damage per application (literal, because the data gives only the per-second number; no spirit scaling). The DoT triggers on-spirit-damage effects (wiki). Close range is affected by ability range.

upgrade_quick_silver.name: Quicksilver Reload

effects.why: Bonus on the imbued ability's first hit, once per 18s charge.
+10% fire rate for 12s after the imbued cast, once per 18s: 0.67 at best.

upgrade_quick_silver.notes: BonusFireRate is NOT flagged conditional in the API: see _about.mislabelled_props. The bonus damage applies only if the imbued ability deals weapon or spirit damage (not pure).

upgrade_cloaking_device_active.name: Shadow Weave

effects.why: Ambush lasts 5s after breaking stealth, once per 37s cooldown, and full strength needs 6s of stealth first: 5/37 = 0.135.
Same ambush window.

upgrade_cloaking_device_active.notes: API and the wiki tooltip agree: +50% weapon damage and +25 SP during a 5s ambush. A wiki note still describes a '25% fire rate' ramp after stealth, which is stale.

upgrade_glass_cannon.name: Glass Cannon

effects.why: +7% fire rate per hero kill, max 8, lose 1 on death. 0.3 is about 2-3 of 8 stacks on average.

effects.reason: The data has a 30% slow from bullet build-up (SlowPercent, BuildUpPerShot, BuildUpDuration) that no wiki or tooltip text mentions. Unknown if live.

upgrade_glass_cannon.notes: +85% weapon damage and -13% max HP are plain stats. effects.conditional_stats() ignores stacks_prop today.

upgrade_ultimate_burst.name: Lightning Scroll

effects.reason: Damage (150 + 0.35 x SP) spirit plus a 0.75s stun after a 3s delay, once per target per ultimate cast. Needs the hero's ultimate cooldown, which is not item data.

upgrade_ultimate_burst.notes: Some heroes cannot buy it (ultimates cannot trigger it). Also carries Mystic Slow effects (24% slow, -12% dash).

upgrade_close_quarter_combat.name: Point Blank
upgrade_close_quarter_combat.notes: No effects listed ON PURPOSE: CloseRangeBonusWeaponPower (+50% weapon damage within 15m) uses MODIFIER_VALUE_CLOSE_RANGE_WEAPON_DAMAGE_INCREASE, which simulate.stats() already applies by target distance. Adding a conditional_stat would double count. The 20% slow on bullets is CC, not modelled. (The prompt guessed upgrade_point_blank; that class does not exist.)

upgrade_burst_fire.name: Burst Fire

effects.why: +32% fire rate for 4.5s when a bullet hits a hero, 9s cooldown: 4.5/9 = 0.5 in sustained fighting.

upgrade_burst_fire.notes: The +10% fire rate is a plain stat.

upgrade_critshot.name: Lucky Shot

effects.why: 25% of bullets deal +100% of the bullet's pre-crit damage: a separate multiplier (~x1.25), not additive weapon damage. The non-crit-share correction is ignored (overstates slightly at high headshot rates).
effects.added_by: main session, from the research's closed form

upgrade_critshot.notes: Bonus damage cannot crit; immune to evasion; pierces Plated Armor on proc.

upgrade_sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
upgrade_sharpshooter.notes: No effects listed ON PURPOSE: LongRangeBonusWeaponPower (+60% beyond 15m) is MODIFIER_VALUE_LONG_RANGE_BULLET_DAMAGE_INCREASE, which simulate.stats() already applies by distance. Other stats are plain.

effects.reason: 60% of bullets ignore the target's bullet resist (and evasion, barriers) and pierce. Wiki: on those bullets all bullet shred becomes ADDITIVE instead of multiplicative, so final resist is presumably 0 - sum(shred) (negative). Expected weapon multiplier = 0.4 x (1 - R_final) + 0.6 x (1 + sum_shred).

upgrade_intensifying_clip.name: Intensifying Magazine

effects.why: Ramps from 0 to +45% weapon damage over 2.5s of continuous fire, presumably resetting when you stop or reload. Over a long magazine the average is close to 45% minus the ramp; 0.6 allows for the ramp and gaps.

upgrade_intensifying_clip.notes: Ramp assumed linear (the wiki says it 'ramps up'). Reset rule on stopping fire is not stated.

upgrade_express_shot.name: Express Shot

effects.reason: Every 8s the next attack fires twice; both shots deal +125% weapon damage (ProcBaseAttackDamagePercent, +2 per boon), cannot crit, use 2 ammo. Extra damage per proc = base attack x (2 x 2.25 - 1). Burst weapons: the first burst's first bullet and the whole second burst get the bonus. Needs per-attack damage.

upgrade_express_shot.notes: ProcBaseAttackDamagePercentAltFire=38 applies to alt-fire weapons (Shiv, Viscous, Yamato, Paradox carbine).

upgrade_tech_overflow.name: Spiritual Overflow

effects.why: Build-up from shooting heroes, then a 15s buff. The rebuild rule is not documented; 0.6 assumes build-up takes a few seconds of shooting per 15s buff.
Same buff window.
Same buff window.

upgrade_tech_overflow.notes: The three buff props are flagged IntrinsicallyProvidedInAbility, NOT ConditionallyApplied, so the simulator currently reads +25% fire rate, +30 SP and +10% spirit lifesteal as permanent: see _about.mislabelled_props. The +15% spirit lifesteal, +8 SP, +13% duration and +90 HP are plain. Build-up accumulates on the target being shot (wiki Build-Up).

effects.reason: Bullets bounce to 2 more enemies within 13m for 65% damage: multi-target only. Ricochet bullets cannot headshot and do not apply Tesla or Siphon Bullets.

upgrade_long_range.name: Long Range
upgrade_long_range.notes: No effects listed ON PURPOSE: +40% weapon damage beyond 15m is MODIFIER_VALUE_LONG_RANGE_BULLET_DAMAGE_INCREASE, already applied by simulate.stats() by distance.

upgrade_withering_whip.name: Rusted Barrel

effects.why: Targeted active: 5s per 16s cooldown = 0.31.

upgrade_withering_whip.notes: Also -32% enemy fire rate (defensive, not modelled).

upgrade_bullet_resist_shredder.name: Bullet Resist Shredder

effects.why: Applied (8s) whenever you deal spirit damage. Near 1.0 with any frequent spirit source (Torment Pulse, Tesla, Mystic Shot, DoTs); lower for pure gun builds. 0.75 is a middle value.

upgrade_bullet_resist_shredder.notes: Does not stack with itself; reapplying refreshes the duration. Teammates benefit. The +9% bullet resist (IntrinsicallyProvidedInAbility) is a plain stat per the wiki.

effects.why: Targeted active: 4.25s per 16s cooldown = 0.27.

effects.reason: Disarms the target (CC).

upgrade_hollow_point_rounds.name: Hollow Point

effects.why: Only while YOU are above 65% health. In a fight to the death you are above that roughly the first half.
Bullets apply the -10% for 8s while you are above 65% HP; the debuff lasts 8s after you drop below.

upgrade_hollow_point_rounds.notes: Wiki update log: -9% -> -10% on 16 Sep 2026, so the API and wiki agree.

upgrade_headshot_booster2.name: Weakening Headshot

effects.why: 12s debuff on any headshot; one headshot per 12s is easy in a sustained fight.

upgrade_headshot_booster2.notes: DiminishingMultiplier=0.5 is in the data with no explanation anywhere (wiki or tooltip). Unknown; maybe a reduction when it overlaps Crippling Headshot from a teammate.

upgrade_banshee_slugs.name: Crippling Headshot

effects.why: 12s debuff per headshot.
Same debuff.

effects.reason: -40% healing received.

upgrade_banshee_slugs.notes: The triggering headshot is not amplified (debuff is applied after). Does not stack with itself. DiminishingMultiplier=0.5 unexplained (as Weakening Headshot).

upgrade_acolytes_glove.name: Spirit Strike

effects.why: Fires on a melee hit against a hero, 8s cooldown (16s for light melee). 0.3 assumes melee in about a third of the cooldown windows; set it per playstyle.
6s debuff per proc, 8s cooldown, times the same melee share.

upgrade_acolytes_glove.notes: 40 + 0.372 x SP spirit damage. Abilities that deal melee damage also trigger it (wiki list).

upgrade_magic_vulnerability.name: Mystic Vulnerability

effects.why: 7s debuff whenever the target takes your spirit damage; refreshes, does not stack.

upgrade_magic_vulnerability.notes: Does not stack with Escalating Exposure's debuff (EE takes priority). The +8% spirit resist is plain.

upgrade_tech_defense_shredders.name: Spirit Shredder

effects.why: Applied by every bullet or melee hit, 8s duration.
Same debuff: +10% spirit lifesteal against the debuffed target for you and allies.

upgrade_tech_defense_shredders.notes: The lifesteal prop uses MODIFIER_VALUE_TECH_DAMAGE_TAKEN_HEALS_ATTACKER and is flagged conditional, so the simulator does not already read it. Wiki: it shares the diminishing (multiplicative) stacking with other spirit lifesteal.

upgrade_spellslinger_headshots.name: Spirit Rend

effects.why: Base debuff from every bullet/melee hit, 8s.
Headshot stacks: -7% each, max 4, 2s proc cooldown, 8s duration refreshed on each stack. Holding 4 needs a headshot every ~2-8s.
+10% spirit lifesteal vs the debuffed target.

upgrade_spellslinger_headshots.notes: Wiki: max is -33.76%, which means the 4 stacks ADD to -28% and that is multiplied with the base -8% (1 - 0.92 x 0.72). So the two separate shred entries here, combined multiplicatively, reproduce it.

upgrade_spirit_snatch.name: Spirit Snatch

effects.why: Melee hit vs a hero, 6s cooldown; light melee effects -30%. 0.3 = assumed melee share.
Steals 12 spirit resist for 10s per proc (6s cooldown): up to 1.0 if meleeing every cooldown; scaled by melee share.
Gain 25 SP for 10s (taken from the target).

upgrade_spirit_snatch.notes: 50 + 0.84 x SP. TechArmorGain (+12 own spirit resist) is defensive. Buffs drop if the marked target dies.

effects.why: -8% for 12s whenever you deal spirit damage.

effects.reason: Stacking spirit amp: +4.5% (MagicIncreasePerStack) of your spirit damage to the target per stack, max 12 (+54%), one stack per 0.7s of spirit damage, 12s duration. Dealt as a separate damage instance after the original (wiki). Roughly a x(1 + 0.045 x avg_stacks) multiplier on spirit damage; no vocabulary type for it.

upgrade_focus_lens.name: Focus Lens

effects.why: Targeted active: -9% for 12s per 40s cooldown = 0.3.

effects.reason: Silences 4.5s; when it ends the target takes 35% of all damage dealt to it during the silence, from all sources, credited to the caster. About +35% damage for 4.5s of every 40s. Also -30 SP to the target.

upgrade_focus_lens.notes: MagicResistReduction has NO ConditionallyApplied flag (it is an enemy debuff); TechPowerReduction is already excluded by data.SCOPED_PROPS.

upgrade_spirit_sap.name: Spirit Sap

effects.why: Targeted active: 12s per 22s cooldown = 0.55.

upgrade_spirit_sap.notes: Also -30 SP to the target (TechPowerReduction, unflagged, already excluded by SCOPED_PROPS). Cooldown went 18 -> 22s on 30 Oct 2026; the API has 22.

upgrade_bullet_armor_reduction_aura.name: Hunter's Aura

effects.why: Passive aura within 15m (ability range applies; since 30 Oct 2026 only with line of sight). 0.7 = share of the fight in range and in sight.

upgrade_bullet_armor_reduction_aura.notes: -10% bullet resist, doubled to -20% (and -30% fire rate) when only ONE enemy hero is nearby (SingleTargetPlayerMultiplier=2; wiki: a plain doubling, not stacking). stacks_prop encodes the 1v1 case; in teamfights use 1. BulletArmorReduction has no provided_property_type in the data. Does not stack across teammates.

upgrade_vampire.name: Bullet Lifesteal
upgrade_vampire.notes: No effects ON PURPOSE: BulletLifestealPercent=15 is an unconditional MODIFIER_VALUE_BULLET_LIFESTEAL that simulate.stats() already reads. Listing it would double count. NOTE: the simulator SUMS lifesteal; the wiki says sources stack multiplicatively (1 - prod(1 - L)).

upgrade_health_stealing_magic.name: Spirit Lifesteal
upgrade_health_stealing_magic.notes: No effects ON PURPOSE: AbilityLifestealPercentHero=15 (MODIFIER_VALUE_TECH_LIFESTEAL, unflagged) is already read. NonHeroAbilityLifestealTooltipOnly=3 suggests 3% (20% of 15%) vs non-heroes; the wiki Lifesteal page says spirit lifesteal is 40% effective vs creeps. Disagreement.

upgrade_endurance.name: Extra Regen
upgrade_endurance.notes: No effects ON PURPOSE: BonusHealthRegen=2.5 (MODIFIER_VALUE_HEALTH_REGEN_PER_SECOND, unflagged) is already read as in-combat regen. OutOfCombatHealthRegen=1.5 does not apply in a fight.

upgrade_health_stimpak.name: Healing Rite

effects.why: Dispelled when you take damage from enemy players or objectives, so it does nothing in a sustained fight. It is for between fights (in_combat false).

upgrade_health_stimpak.notes: 300 total over 20s, 70s cooldown. TotalHealthRegen scale_function is scale_function_healing_spirit_scale with stat_scale 1.1 but no specific_stat_scale_type; the wiki shows '300 x1.1', presumably +1.1 per spirit power. Unconfirmed.

upgrade_medic_bullets.name: Restorative Shot

effects.why: Next bullet after the 6s cooldown; cooldown starts even on a miss (wiki).

upgrade_medic_bullets.notes: 50 from a hero hit, 20 (HealFromNPC) from NPCs/orbs.

upgrade_fury_trance.name: Fury Trance

effects.why: Active: 6.5s per 18s = 0.36. It silences you, so it costs ability damage while up.

effects.reason: Active also gives +40% spirit resist and +1.5m move speed, and silences you (no abilities) and disables stamina for 6.5s.

upgrade_fury_trance.notes: ActiveBonusFireRate has no provided_property_type, so it is not read. TechResist=40 IS typed MODIFIER_VALUE_TECH_RESIST with no conditional flag, so the simulator reads +40% spirit resist as PERMANENT; the wiki tooltip has it only in the active. See _about.mislabelled_props. The +15% bullet lifesteal is plain.

upgrade_damage_recycler.name: Leech
upgrade_damage_recycler.notes: No effects ON PURPOSE: 30% bullet and 30% spirit lifesteal are unconditional and already read.

upgrade_siphon_bullets.name: Siphon Bullets

effects.why: Proc on a bullet hit at most once per 1.2s (ProcCooldown) while shooting.

effects.reason: Each proc also heals you by and raises your max HP by the amount stolen (17s, refreshing, stacks without limit), and lowers the target's max HP; the next proc is based on the reduced max HP (decays). Healing = damage dealt, but is not reduced by healing reduction.

upgrade_siphon_bullets.notes: 2.5% of enemy MAX HP per proc, reduced by falloff. Wiki: the damage is NOT changed by bullet/spirit resist or damage amps. The simulator treats pct_hp as spirit damage and multiplies by spirit resist, which is wrong for this item. Does not proc item effects; Ricochet cannot spread it.

upgrade_infuser.name: Infuser

effects.why: Active: 7s per 30s = 0.23.
Same active.

upgrade_infuser.notes: The passive 15% spirit lifesteal (AbilityLifestealPercentHeroPassive), +8 SP, +10% spirit resist are plain and already read.

upgrade_fervor.name: Frenzy

effects.why: Triggers when you drop below 50% HP: +40% fire rate for 10s, 16s cooldown. In a fight to the death you spend about the second half below 50%, and the buff covers 10 of each 16s.

upgrade_fervor.notes: +15% fire rate, +10% bullet lifesteal, +160 HP are plain. Move speed and debuff resist are not modelled.

upgrade_surging_power.name: Vampiric Burst

effects.why: Active: 5s per 30s = 0.17.
Same active.

effects.reason: Active also adds 75% ammo, not limited by magazine size.

upgrade_surging_power.notes: ActiveBonusLifesteal=75 is typed MODIFIER_VALUE_BULLET_LIFESTEAL with NO conditional flag: the simulator currently reads a PERMANENT 75% bullet lifesteal. See _about.mislabelled_props. The 15% passive lifesteal is plain.

upgrade_juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
upgrade_juggernaut.notes: No effects ON PURPOSE: BonusHealthRegen=15 is unconditional MODIFIER_VALUE_HEALTH_REGEN_PER_SECOND and already read. The -40% fire-rate slow on enemies that shoot you is defensive.

upgrade_boxing_glove.name: Lifestrike

effects.why: Heals on a melee hit, 4s cooldown (6s for light melee). 0.3 = assumed share of cooldowns with a melee hit.

effects.reason: Plus LifestealHealPercent = 35% of the melee damage dealt. Also a 48% slow.

upgrade_boxing_glove.notes: event=hit means a MELEE hit here; the simulator's 'hit' rate is bullet hits, capped by the cooldown, which assumes a melee every cooldown before uptime. LifestealHeal 120 and LifestealHealPercent 35 scale per boon (healing_boon_scale 1.75 and 0.5). 40% effective vs non-heroes.

upgrade_lifestrike_gauntlets.name: Melee Lifesteal

effects.why: Next melee hit heals, 8s cooldown (12s for light melee). 0.3 = assumed melee share.

upgrade_lifestrike_gauntlets.notes: 100 flat. 30% effective vs non-heroes. LifestrikeHealPercent exists in the data with value null. Same melee-not-bullet caveat as Lifestrike.
